8.3 Running water in deserts: the process most answers forget
visual_blocks.preview: 🔑 **Trap:** flash floods are the leading cause of death in many desert regions, and wadis are the most dangerous places to camp or build. "Arid" does not mean "no flood risk"; it means the flood is rare, sudden and channel-focused.
